show.title: Soulection Radio Show #137 w/ Mr. Carmack & Mikos Da Gawd
show.content:
Mikos Da Gawd and Mr. Carmack each drop amazing sets of unreleased, original productions.

show.title: Soulection Radio Show #138 w/ Great Dane
show.content:
Producer Great Dane (co-founder of Team Supreme) delivers energy and bass

<!--more-->


For this show we had the young and progressive producer Great Dane who is the co-founder of one of the best collectives in LA (Team Supreme) and an artist on Alpha Pup. Joe Kay kicked things off for the first hour & 28 minutes of exclusive material ranging from Mr. Carmack, Kaytranada, Sango, Jo Def, Esta, and many others. Great Dane truly understands our memo when we say, 'NO TIME FOR FILLER TRACKS'. As soon as he hit play constant energy and bass started flowing. He played an exclusive 45 minute set which consisted of all original productions except for two tracks. This won't be the last time you hear from him.
 



 Thanks to [true listener^^](https://soundcloud.com/true_listener) for supplying this tracklist.

show.title: Soulection Radio Show #139 w/ DJ Harrison
show.content:
DJ Harrison thows down a crazy live improvised session with the SP-404 and MPC1000

<!--more-->

oe Kay started off with some nice deep/melodic tracks from Mr. Carmack, Christoph El Truento, Dirg Gerner, Iamnobodi, Sango, Last Night In Paris, Geode and many more! Joe took it back to the essence with Ginuwine/Timbaland/Dilla classics! DJ Harrison on the other hand who reminds us of Madlib (no really he does)all the way from Virginia threw down a crazy live session with the SP-404 & MPC 1000. Lots of soulful chops and intricate drum patterns! This is another amazing session from start to finish! Spread this if you feel it.

Thanks to [true listener^^](https://soundcloud.com/true_listener) for supplying this tracklist.

show.title: Soulection Radio Show #144 w/ starRo
show.content:
starRo hails all the way from Tokyo, Japan to play original productions and edits.

<!--more-->

There have been so many guests on Soulection Radio over the past years but no one, we repeat, no one has came in the studio so humble, so low key and just murk the airwaves like starRo did. 
It's crazy to think that this man has been making music for over 15 years and is barely coming to surface to the world with so much heat. 
We are just glad he is on our team. He played nothing but original production/edits. 
Hailing all the way from Tokyo, Japan, starRo is an artist who you will be familiar with starting from this point on. 
Joe Kay of course opened the show for the first hour & 50 minutes on one turntable (one of the turntable's went out before the show started) playing a bunch of heat that he was holding onto since last week. 
He made sure to make up for his absence last saturday and play some exclusive Carmack, Atu, Kaytra, Esta, Esgar, Jo Def + some other heavy footwork vibes.


Thanks to [true listener^^](https://soundcloud.com/true_listener) for supplying this tracklist.

show.title: Soulection Radio Show #147 w/ DJ Nobody
show.content:
We have Low End Theory's very own DJ Nobody in the studio with us. 

<!--more-->
We hope you're ready for not just another great session of musical selections but also a great 25+ minute discussion between DJ Nobody and Joe Kay. 
Joe kicked things off for a little over an hour & 33 minutes with new and forgotten gems. 

Do your research! Nobody made his 1st appearance on the show that was well overdue and went into a heavy/experimental beat journey ranging a variety of BPM's. 
We discussed a bit of his background and really got into the history of Low End Theory and the progression of where it is today. 
Nobody discussed crucial experiences that you would want to know so listen closely. 


Thanks to [true listener^^](https://soundcloud.com/true_listener) for supplying this tracklist.

show.title: Soulection Radio Show #150 w/ SOSUPERSAM
show.content:
Talented & vibrant woman SOSUPERSAM finally came through the studio.

It's been a long time coming and we're happy that you finally get a feel for who she is musically and as a person. Wasn't quite sure what she was gonna play for us, but she showed a great diversity and really brought us back to a place that was very much needed towards the end of her set. She's even cooler as a person. Being humble and driven will always get you far. Joe Kay really brought out a diverse selection of music.

show.title: Soulection Radio Show #152 w/ LIKE (Pac Div)
show.content:
Due to all the adversity we went through with this show we had [LIKE](https://soundcloud.com/callmelike) play music past the last hour and extend all the way for a total of 3 hours & 39 minutes. 
<!--more-->

From the very first minute to the very end we were providing music that you never heard of or forgot about, configuring wires, figuring out audio issues, chopping it up about food, you name it. So much effort went into producing this show. We want to thank our brother LIKE for rolling through and blessing us with a proper DJ set, freestyle over Esta's beat, and talking to us about his experiences growing up and being in Pac Div. This man has traveled the world, played alongside the best in the game, and has also produced for/with the best (Kendrick, The Neptunes, ect). Joe Kay made sure to touch on topics that are very insightful. LIKE will be releasing with us on Soulection so stay tuned! 

Follow LIKE on [Twitter](https://twitter.com/Callmelike) | [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/clearlyitslike/) | [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/callmeLike/)


Thanks to [true listener^^](https://soundcloud.com/true_listener) for supplying this tracklist.

show.title: Soulection Radio Show #164 w/ Jamil & Tunji
show.content:
3 Hours of 'just music' with friends Jamil & Tunji.
<!--more-->

This Soulection Radio session is one for the books! We wanted to switch it up on you, put the full 3 hours of 'just music' aside and inform you with some real knowledge from some great friends of ours who are some very important people that you need to know. Jamil who is Drake's touring manager and G-Eazy's co-manager is someone who has reached out to us and showed us so much support. Tunji on the other hand is an army swiss knife! He is an A&R at Interscope and is one of the most humble and diverse A&R's in the game. One of the few that truly understands the sound of tomorrow and is responsible for some amazing connections going on in the industry. Really listen to what they have to say and take notes!

Thanks to [true listener^^](https://soundcloud.com/true_listener) for supplying this tracklist.

show.title: Soulection Radio Show #165 w/ Lakim, Andres, Sunni Colòn, & J-Louis
show.content:
Soulection 3 Year pre-party Celebration!
<!--more-->

We had a packed house at Kbeach with plenty of good vibes flowing. In fact it was Joe's first time meeting Lakim in person after all these years. This is Lakim's first time out in L.A. so we wanted to make sure Lakim was welcomed properly. We had him drop a quick preview set on the radio show and talk about his forthcoming album "This Is Her" a little. We also had Andres drop a quick set to switch up the vibes, After Andres, we had Sunni Colòn & J-Louis both come on and preview some remixes that we've been putting together. So much talent in one room. Big ups to Marvel Alexander and shouts to everyone who came out to our 3 year Anniversary party. It was massive and hectic at the same time. Stay tuned for our announcement to our new Soulection monthly.

Thanks to [true listener^^](https://soundcloud.com/true_listener) for supplying this tracklist.

show.title: Soulection Radio Show #169
show.content:
Plenty of new music stacked ready to share with you.
<!--more-->

It felt good to be back after being away from the studio for 4 weeks. We've been traveling for the past month spreading The Sound of Tomorrow at SXSW, WMC, and now Asia. The pros of being away for so long meant that Joe stacked up on plenty of music for the past month which makes up for the lost time, trust. There is too much to say and talk about but shout out to all of the amazing people who came out to our shows to see and connect with us. We are very grateful!

Thanks to [true listener^^](https://soundcloud.com/true_listener) for supplying this tracklist.

show.title: Soulection Radio Show #172 w/ Rhettmatic (Beat Junkies)
show.content:
Rhettmatic of the legendary beat Junkies Crew graces us with a 50 minute set + an in depth interview. 

<!--more-->

Rhett is definitely one of the most humble guests we've had on here and is more connected than anyone really knows. Do yourself a favor and get mentally prepared to learn a lot. It's much more than just music. Shouts to Rhettmatic, Mr. Choc, J. Rocc, and the rest of the Beat Junkies crew. Also, big big up to Free The Robots for coming through the studio and vibing with us. Much love to you & the whole Crosby crew. Stay tuned for much more to come. Enjoy.

show.content:
Joe Kay meets up with Japanese DJ [Yukibeb](https://twitter.com/yukibeb) drops a 60-minutes guest mix live in Tokyo. --- Today we're introducing the Black Label Series, which is focused on highlighting rising vocalists/rappers we're going to be working with.
